questions.q: What is the purpose of the notice?
options: To announce a new service for hotel guests
To report the closing of a hotel restaurant
To advertise discounted harbor cruises
To explain a change in check-in procedures

options: By visiting the front desk
By using the telephone in their room
By sending an e-mail to the staff
By filling out a form in the lobby

Requests made after 9:00 P.M. will be handled the following morning." → 직원은 오후 9시까지만 있지만 객실 전화로는 언제든 연락된다. → 보기 "By using the telephone in their room" (dialing 5 from their room telephones = using the telephone in their room)
